step: cook with egg yolks and sugar
text: Egg proteins coagulate as the milk warms and hold the water in a soft gel. A rise of only 3–6 °C past the setting point overcooks and curdles it, so custard is cooked in a water bath or stirred over low heat; a little cornflour makes it more forgiving. Baked custards (crème caramel) set in the oven in a bain-marie.
